heard: Astronauts aboard the space station watch 16 sunrises every day. Picture living inside a Boeing 747 jumbo jetliner. Now, stretch its exterior across a full American football field, place that massive station 250 miles above Earth's surface, now fling it across orbit at 17,500 miles per hour. At that speed, it circles the entire planet every 90 minutes. Yet, after decades in orbit, agencies planned to orbit it around 2030. That is why astronauts in orbit watch 16 sunsets every day.
